codex2 posted canonical SKETCH v1 (BUG-2221), explicitly AWAITING ADVISOR SIGNOFF, source3cbb90b0c94e0e748bbfc4eb1f75d7f9c2125c68. Local copy /tmp/codex2-bug2221-sketch-v1.txt.
Concrete choice: one disposable local per-query negative-history proof cache; Git-owned bounded no-walk batches obtain parents and use the existing Git grep/message parsers. A commit's ancestry is reusable only when every parent is proved negative/closed. Ref movement checks only unresolved cones; positive hits keep original all-ref/date-order path. Cold incomplete work resumes only on requested shows; no daemon/poller or blind store subtraction. Explicit S/R validity, replace/graft/shallow fallback, double-snapshot/ref-movement unknown rules, and deadline/cycle-safe streaming source traversal are specified with named actual-Git/shim/child regressions.
One isolated temporary Git2.43 shape experiment resolved a real validity trap: log --all includes current AND other linked-worktree detached HEADs, whereas rev-parse --all omits both. Therefore the sketch uses Git's actual all-root semantics. Evidence /tmp/codex2-bug2221-gitshape.json. No live Git mutation, source edits or Cargo.
Accounts for~400ms remainder: single pristine clap tree per invocation instead of duplicate name-scan/parse trees, finer phases, no unproved attribution or unsafe HEAD memoization. Does not claim removing885ms alone satisfies acceptance.
Requested signoff rulings are explicit: cold resumable unknown behavior; local derived namespace; foreground scheduling against unchanged1000ms objective, without altering guard1000ms/10%/5000ms or raising existing caps. Positive/unsupported contexts retain truthful fallback, not a cold-complete-in1s promise. Actual default before/after and fresh lineage evidence remain completion gates. This is sketch preparation, no implementation/claim/approval/grants/telemetry changes. PR2919 explicitly routed new-head review remains priority.
subject: BUG2221 SKETCH v1 posted — awaiting signoff, concrete negative-proof algorithm
